title: THE INTERN'S SECRET
synopsis: Victoria Hayes, a confident 32-year-old executive secretary, has spent years keeping her personal life separate from her work. Everything changes when Daniel Cole, a handsome 25-year-old intern, is assigned to work directly under her supervision. Their professional relationship quickly becomes complicated by undeniable chemistry, late-night office hours, and a secret neither can afford to expose.
author: LokkeeVerse
